content: INCONCLUSIVE. No authoritative source found documenting how the Lineage 2 (and specifically XM Essence) party window renders a member who is out of range, zoning, or disconnected. Fragmentary evidence: greyed-out HP bars exist as a distinct state from absent bars in L2 UI; disconnects can occur silently with the character simply freezing. Because the project's death heuristic is 'MP bar present + HP bar empty', any client behavior that blanks or greys HP while keeping the row visible for a distant member would be INDISTINGUISHABLE from death. This must be resolved empirically on the actual client before the detection logic is finalized.
